title: ONE SUPER PAC. SIX CHECKS?!
description: YouTube-style thumbnail: a huge red 97¢ donut chart (of every opposition dollar — one super PAC), six receipt cards each marked OPPOSE: PLATNER with the six real amounts, photos of the race’s two subjects — Susan Collins and Graham Platner — in circles marked VS, and an ALL PUBLIC RECORD stamp.
alt_text: YouTube-style thumbnail. Left: a big red donut chart reading 97 cents of every opposition dollar. Center: text ONE SUPER PAC. SIX CHECKS?! over six receipt cards, each stamped OPPOSE: PLATNER, with amounts from $1,501,012 to $1,999,500. Right: circular photos of Susan Collins and Graham Platner separated by VS. A red stamp reads ALL PUBLIC RECORD.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: YouTube-thumbnail-style graphic. Figures from public FEC filings: $11,077,173 opposing vs $323,426 supporting (deduplicated). Editorial/commentary use; candidate photos are news imagery of the race’s subjects.
